status_rules.R1-NUMERICAL: a determining evaluation reports non-convergence and no verified measurement exists -> NUMERICAL_FAILURE
status_rules.R2-FAIL-MEASURED: a verified, measured, in-domain determining measurement violates the requirement -> FAIL
status_rules.R3-PASS: every verified, measured, in-domain determining measurement meets the requirement, at least one covers it completely, and the requirement basis is frozen -> PASS
status_rules.R3b-BASIS-NOT-FROZEN: measurements would pass but the requirement basis is not frozen (official RFP not obtained, owner rows 1-3) -> INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE
status_rules.R3c-COVERAGE: verified measurements exist but none covers the requirement completely -> INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE
status_rules.R4-FAIL-FLOOR: a determining budget evaluation whose floor is a VERIFIED lower bound exceeds the limit under EVERY admissible open reading -> FAIL
status_rules.R5-OUT-OF-DOMAIN: determining evaluations exist and every one lies outside its applicability domain -> OUT_OF_DOMAIN
status_rules.R6-INCOMPLETE: a determining evaluation was run in domain with at least one evidenced (non-allocation, non-TBD) term but cannot conclude -> INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE
status_rules.R7-NOT-EVALUATED: no determining evaluation with evidenced terms exists (plans, frameworks, allocations, analogs or unavailable analyses only) -> NOT_EVALUATED

evidence_rule: PASS only with a DETERMINING artifact of kind MEASUREMENT that is measured, verified, non-synthetic, in domain, meets and covers the requirement, and a frozen requirement basis; FAIL only from such a measurement or from a VERIFIED lower-bound floor exceeding the limit under every admissible open reading (docs/EVIDENCE.md; CLAUDE.md rules 6, 10)

text.p1_before_freeze: progressive electron-current capability sweep; never PASS because 1 A, 2 A, ... is reached; report the surface I_e = f(P_RF, p, mdot, Z_ICP, V_collector) until the H-1 requirement is known

conditions: Hall discharge supply OFF and electrically disconnected from the H-1 anode
electrons extracted to a dedicated, isolated, instrumented electron-collecting electrode
gas, magnetic field, pressure and geometry corresponding to the registered H-1 operating condition
matched RF-OFF measurements quantify facility/background electron current
text.definition_recorder_reading: I_e,cap = I_e,collector,RFON - I_e,collector,RFOFF, subject to current-path closure and the registered uncertainty treatment. The verbatim formula lacks 'I_e,cap =' and the minus sign; this reading follows the owner's 'matched RF-OFF measurements used to quantify facility/background electron current' and the verified P1 reducer (I_e_icp_corrected = I_e,RF-on - I_e,RF-off). Owner may correct.
text.qualification: I_e,cap >= I_d,max,H1 with the preregistered one-sided lower confidence bound on M_n = I_e,cap/I_d,max,H1 - 1 remaining above zero
text.hall_on: Hall-ON measurements are retained only as NEUTRALIZATION_CONSISTENCY, never ICP45_CAPACITY (with Hall ON, I_e,ICP ~ I_d because the anode closes the discharge circuit)
text.hall_on_follow_up: after discharge-OFF capacity is shown, repeat the corresponding Hall-ON point and verify sustainment, current closure, neutralization behaviour, stability, collector/reference potentials, RF power

text.anode: physically disconnected from the discharge supply and left floating during ICP-45 discharge-OFF capacity measurements (never a commanded-zero supply left attached); V_anode recorded on a high-impedance isolated channel; anode terminal classified OPEN_CIRCUIT_BY_CONSTRUCTION
text.body: H-1 body/magnetic circuit has exactly one deliberate facility-ground connection through an instrumented/metered return (ground-current monitor); no second chassis/stand/coax/shield grounding path; I_body->ground measured continuously during capacity measurements
text.closure: Kirchhoff residual per ICP-45 point, e.g. I_collector + I_body + I_anode + I_facility + I_ICP,body ~ 0 under the registered sign convention; a large unexplained residual invalidates that capacity point
text.measurand: only the dedicated electron-collector current is the capacity measurand; current into H-1 body, facility ground, chamber, floating anode or unintended cable shields does not count
text.diagnostic_variant: a metered-return anode configuration may later be run as a separately registered diagnostic; it never replaces the floating-anode baseline because it gives a larger current

text.sign_convention: one global convention for every ICP-45 capacity record: conventional current INTO the defined isolated electrical network is positive; every channel transformed into it before analysis
text.terms: signed I_ecollector, I_H1,body, I_anode, I_facility, I_ICP,body and any other intentional terminal crossing the registered network boundary, where physically present/measurable
text.floating_anode: I_anode ~ 0 by construction in the floating-anode ICP45_CAPACITY baseline; its potential is still recorded
text.no_silent_zero: an unavailable current channel is never silently set to zero
text.uncertainty: u_R = sqrt(sum_k u^2(I_k)) for independent calibrated channels, each u(I_k) including calibration, zero/offset, resolution, repeatability where applicable and any registered RF-pickup contribution; full covariance form when correlations are established
text.admission: closure-valid only if |R_I| <= 3 u_R AND |R_I| / max(I_e,collector, I_scale,min) <= 0.02; I_scale,min is a small registered denominator floor from instrument capability (value registered, not set here)
text.instrument_adequacy: if 3 u_R > 0.02 I_e,collector at a candidate qualification point, the point is NOT_EVALUATED_INSTRUMENT; the tolerance is never widened; the 2 % criterion is never relaxed after observing propulsion results
exclusions: current sign conventions differ between channels
an intentional return path is unmeasured
an unintended ground path is found
H-1 anode not physically disconnected/floating in an ICP45_CAPACITY record
text.excluded_points: remain in the raw record with the exclusion reason

text.formula: I_e,cap = I_e,collector,RFON - I_e,collector,RFOFF (the A9.4 recorder reading, confirmed; the verbatim block again lacks 'I_e,cap =' and the minus sign), signed currents under the same registered convention
